overall: The AG found the Dudley Planning Board intentionally violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating privately during a March 25 recess on a solar permit vote, and referred the matter to a hearing with recommended penalties and orders.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged that a quorum of the Planning Board left the March 25 meeting during a recess and deliberated privately about a solar permit vote.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board improperly deliberated during a recess of its March 25 meeting and that this deliberation was intentionally done behind closed doors and outside of the public's view.

remedy: Civil penalty of $1,000 (recommended for imposition at the hearing)
Nullification of the vote taken immediately following the improper deliberation (recommended)
Order of immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, G.L. c. 30A, §§ 23(c)(1), (3), (4) (recommended)
remedy_passage: We recommend the following orders be imposed;
